content: When a seed changes a cross-crate contract (pub fn/type/signature consumed outside its crate, e.g. inherit_parent_target), the implementer must rg the workspace for callers and existing tests of the changed symbol and run focused tests (cargo nextest run -p <caller-crate> <name-filter>) in addition to the touched-crace just verify implementer call — never the caller's full crate suite or the workspace suite. Evidence: run 01M2GVW7GGGB19ZZ9NBN2H5FDC, where crate-scoped verify missed fabro-server fixture drift, the first gate red (~557 KB log) was the only signal, and the focused retest cost 0.37 s.

Extend the step-6 cheapest-first sentence in .fabro/workflows/develop/prompts/planner.md, not a new section: grep/parse-level verification must precede any build-level probe in every brief; compile/test probes must state timeout_ms >= 600000; never run cargo run cold — build once (cargo build, timeout_ms >= 600000) then invoke target/debug/<bin>. Root cause evidence: run 01M2Q7VVH 180s cold-timeout failure.

title: Planner-preflight is report-only; no goal gates on guard-bypassed nodes
rationale: A commit subject naming a seed id is not closure evidence (reopen/verify commits match too, fabro-395b); closure authority stays in the planner arm + review-protected closeout. Terminal goal-gate checks kill deterministic guard exits (incident 2026-09-19, fabro-92e2).

name: guard-report-planner-decides
description: Deterministic guard nodes before an LLM planner: guards may EXACT-check (empty tracker, landed evidence) and REPORT tables inline, but routing decisions with judgment load stay with the LLM node whose own exit edges satisfy any gates. Cost optimization belongs in evidence-gathering (tables prevent re-grepping, fabro-a32f's bash.143), never in mechanical closure side effects — those strand on failed run branches (incident 2026-09-19).
